hero.body: Apply for a trade, train with your trainers, and earn a certificate any employer can check in seconds, with every skill you master on your own Skill Passport.

verify.title: Hiring a KISS trainee?
verify.body: Check any certificate in seconds. Type the ID printed under its QR code, or scan the code with your phone. No account needed.
verify.label: Certificate ID
verify.hint: Shows only the name, course, grade, date and whether it is valid.
verify.invalid: Enter the certificate ID: letters and numbers, at least 8.

journey.title: From your first day to your first job

apply.title: Apply
apply.body: Choose a training cycle and up to three courses in the order you want them.

train.title: Train
train.body: Follow your attendance, marks and skills as your trainers record them, with help when you need it.

certify.title: Get certified
certify.body: Finish the course and receive a certificate with a QR code that anyone can verify.

passport.title: Show your skills
passport.body: Share your Skill Passport with employers and find internships and jobs that match.

language.title: In your language
language.body: Everything in English, ଓଡ଼ିଆ and हिन्दी. Switch any time.

phone.title: On any phone
phone.body: Light and fast, even on a slow mobile connection.

support.title: Help before you fall behind
support.body: Trainers see early when someone needs support, and act on it together.
